**Counting service declarations**

I need to count all service declarations in the direct proto API v1. Since I can't use `rg`, I'll consider using `awk` instead of relying on grep. I can list the files and invoke `awk` to search through the proto files. The command I’m thinking of is `awk '/^service / ...' proto/api/v1/*.proto`, which would help in printing out the services. This approach should work well!
